description: This file implements the advanced state-access functions and related property management for the Slap Loam Broker Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component. It includes functions to get object interfaces, retrieve and set properties, reset properties and states, and manage object bindings.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLboGetAnscCpcIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the object state representing the ANSC Cpc Interface handle from the Slap Loam Broker Object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLboGetAnscLpcConnector(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the object state representing the ANSC Lpc Connector handle from the Slap Loam Broker Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboGetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hProperty)
methods.description: Fills the provided property handle with the current property values of the Slap Loam Broker Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboSetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hProperty)
methods.description: Copies the provided property data into the Slap Loam Broker Object, updating its configuration.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboResetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the property of the Slap Loam Broker Object to its default state, specifically setting MyAddress to IPV4_LOOPBACK_ADDRESS.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboReset(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the state of the Slap Loam Broker Object by invoking deletion of all object bindings and other reset procedures.
